name: camera
does: Moves a camera over the shot (pan, zoom, dolly). The projection (flat, perspective, isometric) tilts flat 2D layers; over an iso or three part, already 3D, only the move applies.
example: Flat blocks as an isometric city the camera dollies into: {"projection": "isometric", "move": "dolly-in"}; over an iso diorama keep "projection": "flat".
